Interface ReactiveUpdateOperation.TerminatingUpdate<T>

All Superinterfaces:
ReactiveUpdateOperation.FindAndModifyWithOptions<T>, ReactiveUpdateOperation.TerminatingFindAndModify<T>
Enclosing interface:

public static interface ReactiveUpdateOperation.TerminatingUpdate<T> extends ReactiveUpdateOperation.TerminatingFindAndModify<T>, ReactiveUpdateOperation.FindAndModifyWithOptions<T>
